intent: Execute the approved specs/delay/core/core.task.COR-work.md using the installed SDD execution flow. When both numeric arguments are invalid, choose a stable diagnostic priority (value first or limit first). Integration consumes only RangeError. Record the non-obvious diagnostic choice and evidence before applying it; do not seek a new product approval merely for this internal choice.
acceptance: boundedDelay receives value and limit in milliseconds. For finite nonnegative numbers return the smaller number, including zero. Reject a non-number, non-finite number or negative argument with RangeError. Never wait, sleep, perform I/O or mutate input. Error message text and internal implementation are not otherwise prescribed.
